lead: `target/debug/nvs.exe` is not what the pipeline builds, so a probe run on it can test a binary days old or none at all.
body: The sweep, `bun nv verify`, `bun nv try` and `bun nv reference` build and run `target/covws/<host triple>/debug/nvs.exe` (`tools/nv/lib/covws.ts`), and only a `cargo build` by hand writes `target/debug`. Where a bullet or a habit names `target/debug/nvs.exe`, run the covws binary, or `cargo build` first.
